200 Returned if the folder list for the current user was successfully retrieved.
403
Returned if you do not have permissions to view the folder list. For more information, see Roles and
Permissions.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable Web App Scanning.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of objects [ items
non-empty
]
A list of reasons for the Tenable Web App Scanning error.
